description: Observed anomaly: category/item lookup surfaces show empty results in 3 different UI entry points despite backend data existing. Not fixed here (portal-explorer does not judge correctness) -- recorded as OBSERVED_CURRENT for QA follow-up.

entries.note: Fired when opening artwork's 'Choose from clipart category' tab (asset picker at add-layer time). Returns EMPTY ARRAY even though clipart_categories GraphQL table has 10+ rows for this user (see below). This appears to be the actual data source for that tab's category tree, which renders 'Select a category on the left' with no items.

entries.request_body_query: { categories: clipart_categories(where: {type: {_eq: "clipart"}, deleted_at: {_is_null: true}, parent_id: {_is_null: true}}, order_by: {created_at: desc}, limit: 25) { id type parent_id label: name __typename } }
entries.note: A DIFFERENT component (GraphQL clipart_categories table) DOES return data with 10 rows, fired around the same time as the broken REST call above. Two different data sources for what looks like the same 'clipart category' concept -- one returns data, the other (used by the actual tree UI) returns empty.

entries.surface: Layer Design Settings 'Select one clipart category' inline 'Search top-level category' textbox
entries.observation: Typing text into this textbox fired ZERO network requests (verified via browser_network_requests before/after typing 'QA-TEST-clipart'). No dropdown ever appears under this specific inline search box.
entries.network_entry_labels_note: unknown -- no request to label, since none fired

entries.surface: Same field's separate 'Search' modal (triggered by clicking 'Search' link)
entries.observation: This alternate modal DOES work correctly and lists all categories with thumbnails, including newly created ones. Selecting a category here correctly populates the 'Select one/a group of clipart categories' field.
entries.network_entry_labels_note: mapped -- confirmed working path used to complete NHOM 2 configuration

entries.observation: After linking category 6202 (which has 2 confirmed items, ids 42387/42388) to a group-clipart-categories layer, opening 'Group's default value' combobox shows literal text 'List is empty.' -- despite the SAME category's items rendering correctly (with real thumbnails) in the SINGLE clipart-category layer's own 'Clipart category's default value' picker moments earlier in the same session.
entries.network_entry_labels_note: unknown -- no distinguishing network request captured separately for this combobox's data source
